findings.location: content.body.steps[id=s2].blocks[0].text: "Усі інші дієслова правильні, навіть ті, що змінюються в теперішньому часі: основу беремо з інфінітива."
findings.description: This categorical claim extends beyond the three basic irregular models and overlooks derivatives of ver. For example, prever has preveía, whereas removing -er and adding -ía would produce incorrect *prevía. The displayed examples themselves are correct.
findings.suggestion: Describe ser, ir and ver as the three basic irregular models, acknowledge that derivatives can inherit their irregularity, and restrict the infinitive-stem rule to regular imperfect forms. Use the same qualification in the summary.

items.reviewerAnswer: Regular -er/-ir imperfect endings are -ía, -ías, -ía, -íamos, -íais, -ían. The listed present-tense stem changes disappear. The basic irregular models are ser, ir and ver; derivatives can inherit their irregularity.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario panhispánico de dudas, entry «prever»: conjugation follows ver (from memory).
